description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Scott)] and [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Scott)
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Spellblade abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Spellblade abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Scott)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Scott)
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Spellblade abilities, causes [Imperil Prismatic 20%] after using Spellblade abilities if 0-3 FF2 allies are alive, grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)] to all allies after using Spellblade abilities if 0-3 FF2 allies are alive, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2] and [Deadly Strikes +20% 2] to the user after using Spellblade abilities if 4+ FF2 allies are alive

description.name: ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)
description.text: ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25%

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 2
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
